description: Up to 25 stock passports in one call, one per ISIN, each the same document as stock_passport. PAID, fifty cents a call over x402 (or a plan), not per ISIN; a malformed ISIN or a list in which none has a token in issue is refused before any payment, and ISINs not found are named in `notFound`. WHY readOnlyHint IS false: calling it WITH an x402 payment authorisation transfers USDC from the caller to us and records a receipt.
